caption: The drawing depicts a single, high-ankled, button-up boot, oriented to the right side of the image. The boot is drawn in a light beige or cream color, with subtle shading to indicate texture and creases in the material. The design features a series of buttons running vertically along the side, with a curved seam extending from the ankle area toward the toes. The toe is pointed, and the heel is moderately low with a slight curve. The boot occupies the central area of the composition, and the background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorative elements present.
title: Woman's Shoe
